name: Dont Blink
summary:
Don't Blink is a multiplayer VR horror game by TripleCGames that drops you and your friends into the Backrooms — an endless expanse of flickering fluorescent lights, damp carpet, and the constant hum of something that should not be there.
Level 1 — The Office
Explore the iconic yellow-wallpapered corridors of Level 1 with up to 10 players. A relentless entity roams the halls, hunting by sight and sound. Coordinate with your team using real-time proximity voice chat — but be careful, it can hear you too.
